free_tier_limits: 50,000 free starter transactions for a limited time; then $0.0045 per transaction under MapQuestGO
resolution_notes: pricing.free_tier_limits: auditor correct. Official Pricing & Plans (https://developer.mapquest.com/plans/) states MapQuestGO is pay-as-you-go with “50,000 free for a limited time” then “$0.0045/transaction”; FAQ on the same page confirms “For a limited time, MapQuestGO includes 50,000 free starter transactions, then bills usage at $0.0045 per transaction.” Original “unknown — verify…” is outdated.
